profiles.meeting_scenario: A planning meeting in an ML research lab between a principal investigator and a postdoctoral researcher about a 6-week internal replication-and-extension of a paper on using beta-VAE latent spaces to generate pragmatic designs of experiments for constrained mixed-level factorial problems. They already agree on the broad direction: construct a constrained synthetic design space, train a beta-VAE on feasible trials, inspect the 2D latent representation, and generate a small pragmatic DOE using clustering and aggregated gradient guidance. The agenda is to pin down what the first milestone includes, which benchmark artifact they will start from, what 'ready' results should look like for the next group methods sync, and who will own implementation versus framing. The expected outcome is a division of responsibilities and a timeline for an initial milestone that both believe is a solid replication starting point.

members.name: Dr. Maya Chen
members.expertise: representation learning, experimental design methodology, research framing
members.background: Maya leads a university ML methods group focused on interpretable generative models for scientific workflows and often shapes early project milestones around figures and narratives that can be shown in lab reviews or seed-grant updates.
members.private_state: She wants a clean, presentable milestone quickly for an upcoming faculty methods review and is quietly trying to keep the first week tightly bounded so the project does not expand into infrastructure work.
hidden_assumptions: A 'replication first' milestone means reproducing the paper's core story on one well-behaved constrained benchmark with a convincing 2D figure and one decoded G-DOE example.
A 'working latent space' is primarily something visible in the map: separated structure, constraint-shaped occupancy, and plausible decoded trials.
The 'benchmark design from the notes' refers to the single curated 24-factor mixed-level synthetic case from her summary slides, with one fixed constraint set already chosen for a clean illustration.

If they agree to have 'initial results by Friday,' that means Arjun will use the lab's existing beta-VAE notebook stack and bring draft figures or example outputs, not spend most of the week on pipeline scaffolding.

members.name: Dr. Arjun Patel
members.expertise: unsupervised learning, empirical evaluation, reproducible ML pipelines
members.background: Arjun recently joined from an industrial research team where reproductions were judged by whether results were stable across seeds, tracked cleanly, and reusable by others rather than by a single illustrative run.
members.private_state: He wants the project to be technically credible and reusable beyond a one-off demo, and he is concerned that a visually polished but weakly validated milestone will create cleanup work later.
hidden_assumptions: A 'replication first' means rebuilding enough of the paper's pipeline that the main claims can be checked in a reproducible way, including the supporting analyses needed to rule out seed luck.
A 'working latent space' should satisfy the paper's claimed properties through diagnostics that are reasonably stable across multiple runs, not only through one attractive visualization.

The 'benchmark design from the notes' refers to the benchmark package in the shared draft folder: the main 24-factor case plus nearby constrained variants used to see whether the approach survives different infeasible-region densities.
If they agree to have 'initial results by Friday,' that still includes setting up tracked runs, configs, and at least a small seed sweep so Friday's outputs are trustworthy enough to build on.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They repeatedly agree to 'do a replication first' before any extension.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 means a narrow replication of the central narrative on one benchmark: feasible-trial filtering, 2D beta-VAE embedding, one clustering- or gradient-guided grid, and a demonstrative decoded design.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 means a broader reproduction package: the core pipeline plus enough repeat runs and support checks to verify that the latent-space claims and generated-design behavior are not fragile.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: In ML research, 'replication first' is a normal phrase that sounds sufficiently concrete, and both participants assume their own lab-culture default for what a proper replication includes without feeling any need to unpack it.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree to aim for a 'working latent space' before spending time on the generated DOE examples.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 believes the latent space is working once the 2D map looks organized, constraints seem reflected in occupied regions, and decoding selected latent points yields plausible feasible trials for the demo.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 believes the latent space is working only if orthogonality/disentanglement-related behavior and feasibility propagation are backed by quantitative diagnostics with acceptable consistency across several seeds.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The phrase sounds like routine shorthand for model readiness, and because both are domain experts discussing a familiar beta-VAE workflow, each assumes the success standard is self-evident.

misalignment_points.topic: Which benchmark artifact 'the notes' point to
misalignment_points.surface_form: They discuss starting from 'the benchmark design from the notes.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 is thinking of the single curated 24-factor mixed-level synthetic benchmark in her summary deck, already paired with one fixed feasibility-rule set chosen to make a readable 2D figure.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 is thinking of the benchmark package linked in the shared draft folder, containing the 24-factor case plus two nearby variants with different constraint densities for quick robustness checks.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both genuinely believe there is one obvious benchmark source because the deck and the draft folder were circulated close together and have both been referred to informally as 'the notes' in previous messages.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree that Arjun will have 'initial results by Friday.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: M1 expects Friday to mean a quick prototype using existing lab notebooks, manual inspection of a few runs, and draft latent-space figures or a decoded grid example ready to react to.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: M2 expects Friday to mean the first trustworthy outputs from a minimally reproducible setup with experiment tracking, config files, and a small seed sweep, even if the figures are not yet polished.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The phrase is outcome-oriented and sounds practical rather than methodological, so neither participant feels compelled to spell out the hidden workflow assumptions behind what kind of work must happen before something counts as 'results.'

For the methods review, a presentable core story matters more than building infrastructure.
